facts.fact: The Herald reports that on 14 April 2025 the Zimbabwean government launched DuraIsiphala263, a home-designed and home-made higher education management information system built through local expertise from Zimbabwean institutions, with no outside contractor named.

The Herald reports DuraIsiphala263, designed and developed locally, was launched on 14 April 2025 after piloting with 89 percent of higher and tertiary institutions, and is providing summary statistics.

systems.owner: Ministry of Higher and Tertiary Education, Innovation, Science and Technology Development
